1.consolidated_definition: Acción de someter un material usado a determinados procesos para que se pueda volver a utilizar. Usual. DRAE: desde 2001. El ayuntamiento alega que cedió mediante un contrato la administración y operación del vertedero con el fin de que la compañía privatizadora establezca una planta de reciclaje y procesamiento de desperdicios sólidos (Primera Hora, 10-10-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Action of subjecting used material to certain processes so that it can be reused. Usual. 

Note: The term "vertedero" (landfill) is a common term in Puerto Rico and other Spanish-speaking countries, but for the sake of clarity and precision, I have translated it as "landfill" or implied its meaning within the context.

However, if you want to keep the original term, here's an alternative translation:

Action of subjecting used material to certain processes so that it can be reused. Usual. The municipality claims that it contracted out the administration and operation of the landfill with the aim that the private company establish a recycling plant and processing facility for solid waste (First Hour, 10-10-05)
